# SC5 - regeneration from a fresh clone
# Captured 2026-09-04T01:45:34Z.
#
# Method: clone each repository's pass-0043-examples branch fresh under
# harness scratch/sc5, build the module where output/ is not committed, run
# ONE regeneration command per repository, then compare the regenerated file
# with the committed blob from that same clone (git show HEAD:<path>).
#
# Normalisation before hashing, and why each is needed:
#   tr -d '\r'   .gitattributes normalises the repository to LF, so a file
#                 written on Windows differs from its own blob by EOL alone.
#   generatedAt   ConvertTo-GraphRenderViewModel stamps meta.generatedAt from
#                 [DateTime]::UtcNow and ignores the producer's own
#                 graph.meta.generatedUtc, so three of the four cannot be
#                 byte-identical across runs. PSGraphRender has no timestamp
#                 at all and matches byte-for-byte without this rule.
#
# Commands run, one per repository:
#   PSGraphRender        examples/Build-Examples.ps1 -Only callflow
#   PSGraphRenderToHtml  examples/Build-Examples.ps1 -Only explicit
#   PSAzureDevOpsGraph   examples/Build-Examples.ps1 -Offline
#   PSTerraformGraph     examples/Build-Examples.ps1 -Offline

clones:

  PSGraphRenderToHtml @ 55deb2896a85aa9c7ae7e9afbbf2e93011b2342d
  PSAzureDevOpsGraph @ 5551a20efeece2f1e39d7ab9335ad16b6164e135
  PSTerraformGraph @ 0db7f1a7258b3fe56158b5fc6f3eb537f272d430
